objective_summary.value: The primary goal of the FLEX-2 flight experiments is to extend FLEX-1 results to conditions mimicking real combustor environments and provide benchmark data on bi-component droplet combustion to validate numerical simulations and theoretical models.
objective_summary.quote: The primary goal of the FLEX-2 flight experiments is to extend the results of FLEX-1 to fuels and environmental conditions that mimic real combustor conditions, as well as, provide benchmark experimental data on bi-component droplet combustion over a wide range of initial conditions in order to validate numerical simulations and to develop new theoretical models.

earth_applications.value: Insights gained from these studies can lead to more efficient and cleaner combustion technologies, reducing pollution and greenhouse gas emissions while supporting sustainable energy production and improved combustor designs.
